title: Owner's visual review of the desk at HEAD on the Mac
notes: On 2026-10-28 the Qt desk ran on the Mac against `main` (backend built in a local Alpine container, `tests/qt_preview.py` with a mock master, no tablet): the pager names split sections with their part (`AUTO + ELEGIR 1/2`, `GOLPES 1/2`, `GOLPES 2/2`), the colour-hit bolt sits centred on each swatch with no plate. The owner's first look, the same night, found two faults, both fixed: the bolt stayed white on pure green (a luma threshold of 150 put `#00ff00` at 149.7, 1.28:1), so the ink is now the one with the higher WCAG contrast, every Vibra swatch at 4.8:1 or more, red, orange, magenta, pink and azure included; and the 44 px GOLPES DE COLOR switch took a row of room from the swatches. A one-line 168x32 switch was still too big, so the switch is now the bolt alone, a 28 px square, on the heading row (`TILE_ICON`), the heading reads GOLPES DE COLOR while hits are on (`desk_panel_title`, framebuffer and Qt), and the swatches grow from 55 to 62 px. The switch takes touches over a 44 px square centred on the bolt (`desk_placement_target`, declared to the hit audit), so a finger 8 px off it still turns it. On, the switch is the highlighted square with no accent bar, on both desks (owner, 2026-10-29: the bar looked awful and crossed the bolt). On 2026-11-01 HEAD ran on the physical tablet (temporary RAM install, linked to the mini's QLC+ at 192.168.1.87) and every tab and family was captured; the three faults found there are fixed: the pager no longer appends "+N" (`ELEGIR 1/2`), PIXELES picks read `Efecto N`, and PRISMA lists the six beam numbers as one row and `Todos` with the two spins as another (spectalive/qlctool v0.2.7, map regenerated). Next: the owner names anything else to tune.
